gen_text: The system shall allow only users holding the accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The system shall protect customer personal data and bank account numbers by encrypting them in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.
Customer name, address and phone number are mandatory and stored as non-empty strings.
Given a valid customer input, When the customer is created, Then the record persists with the provided attributes.
A customer may have zero or one bank account; attempts to add a second bank account are rejected.
Bank account data is stored encrypted at rest and in transit.
Given a customer without a bank account, When the customer adds a bank account, Then the account is linked to the customer.
Product name, description, price and image are mandatory; price is a decimal number.
The system rejects creation of a product when any mandatory attribute is missing.
Given valid product data, When the product is saved, Then it is persisted and can be referenced by order items.

Given a known customer, at least one order item referencing existing products, and a valid payment method, When the order is submitted, Then the system creates an order with status submitted, order date set to the submission time, and total amount calculated as Σ(quantity × unit price).
Given an order with status submitted, When the staff receives the order, Then the status changes to pending.
Given an order with status submitted, When the staff attempts to receive it, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains submitted.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff marks it as filled, Then the status changes to filled.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff attempts to mark it as filled, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains pending.
Given an order with status pending, When the staff declines the order, Then the status changes to closed.
Given an order with status filled, When the staff ships the order, Then the status changes to shipped.
Given an order with status shipped whose invoice is not paid, When the staff attempts to close the order, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains shipped.
Given a filled or shipped order without an existing invoice, When the accountant raises an invoice, Then an invoice is created with status issued, the supplied date, amount, and payment method.
Given an order that already has an invoice, When the accountant attempts to raise another invoice, Then the system rejects the request.
Given an order with status submitted, pending or closed, When the accountant attempts to raise an invoice, Then the system rejects the request.
Given an invoice with status issued, When the customer submits a payment with a valid payment method, Then a payment record is created with status pending.
Given an invoice with status paid, When the customer attempts to submit a payment, Then the system rejects the request.
Given an invoice whose previous payment has status failed, When the customer submits a new payment, Then the new payment is created with status pending and the failed payment remains failed.
Given a payment with status pending, When the accountant confirms it, Then the payment status becomes completed and the related invoice status changes to paid.
Given a payment with status pending, When the accountant rejects it, Then the payment status becomes failed and the invoice and order statuses remain unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to confirm or reject it, Then the system rejects the request and the status remains unchanged.
Given a shipped order whose associated invoice has status paid, When the staff closes the order, Then the order status becomes closed.
Once an order reaches status closed, no further status changes are allowed.
Order status is restricted to the enum values submitted, pending, filled, shipped, closed.
The system rejects creation of a customer record when any mandatory attribute is missing.
All monetary values (product price, unit price, order total, invoice amount, payment amount) are stored as decimal numbers.
